state:
- S1–S3 are listed as premises and ranking PMIDs for a teriflunomide–DHODH differentiation claim they do not support; they only describe ROS-low stem cells, cytarabine-residual oxidative cells, and venetoclax–azacitidine OXPHOS effects. Restrict the supporting premise to S4 plus the explicitly unverified pharmacology, and cite S1–S3 only as negative-control contexts.
- The go/no-go requires unbound Cmax and marrow free level to exceed a dihydroorotate/UTP shift by threefold, which compares a concentration with a metabolite change. Lock two separate criteria: a uridine-rescueable fold DHO rise and UTP fall, and a margin in which clinical unbound Cmax and measured marrow free drug are at least threefold the albumin-matched free concentration that produces that shift.
- The day-7 assay is not executable as written and one readout conflicts with the mechanism: culture cytokines, serum or stroma, venetoclax–azacitidine doses, and the ROS dye are unspecified; myeloid maturation often increases G0/G1, so demanding maturation beyond G0/G1 arrest can fail a true differentiation hit; and the pilot that sets the mean-plus-3-SD bar is not held out from the 12-donor 8/12 rule. Prespecify the culture system and comparator doses, score morphology plus surface markers with a cell-cycle pattern that allows maturation-associated G0, and freeze thresholds on an independent pilot.
